fieldValues.title: G3 Accountable decisions
fieldValues.summary: A decision can be refined across several sessions and linked to declared participation and ratification without making any session the owner of the decision.
fieldValues.body:
## Group Need

We need to say when a decision was made, who participated and whether the group actually ratified it.

## Semantic Adds

- Session Record
- declared participation
- considered-in and ratified-in relations
- ratification event or lifecycle transition

## Blueprint Adds

- accountable-decision review
- session and ratification summary

## Does Not Introduce

- formal roles or mandates
- a full identity system
- TSS or transcript ingestion
- AI assistance

## Activation Trigger

A group needs the participation, timing or authority of a decision to be inspectable.
